  4)        Construct a 2D matrix representation of the world using the following placement:  
  
  Pit at (1,2), (3,3); Wumpus at (2,3); Gold at (4,4)  
  A)                                                                                              (5)  
  You have to mark cells affected by breeze or stench using adjacency rules. Show how an  
  agent would use this grid to infer safe paths.  
  
  B)   Generate equivalent FOPL statements for the followings:  
  
  i) All students submit assignments on time  
  ii) Some teachers use digital boards                                                       (5)  
  iii) No vehicles are allowed inside the campus  
  iv) Every robot follows instructions  
  
  5)        Examine and analyze the structural and expressive differences between propositional  
  logic and predicate logic. Compare their capabilities, limitations, and suitability for  
  (5)  
  representing real-world AI knowledge with examples.  
  A)  
  B)   An AI system for disease detection uses Bayesian reasoning.  
  Given the following probabilities:  
  
  $$P(Cough) = 0.25$$  
  
  $$P(Tuberculosis) = 0.05$$  
  
  $$P(Cough | Tuberculosis) = 0.85                                                             (5)$$  
  
  Task:  
  Use Bayes' Theorem to compute the probability that a person has tuberculosis given that  
  they have a cough, i.e.,  
  P(Tuberculosis | Cough).  
  Clearly explain each step in your calculation.
